notes.title: Issue Tracker now live!
notes.content:
Hello all,

We are now excited to launch our new [URL=https://forums.frontier.co.uk/threads/frontier-issues-tracker.507703]Issue Tracker[/URL]! The Issue Tracker replaces our Bug Reporting forums and can be accessed here:

[URL]https://issues.frontierstore.net/[/URL]

To report a bug, simply log in with your regular Frontier account and click 'Submit Report'. You'll then be given all the steps you need to let us know about any issues you have experienced.

On this site you can:
[LIST]
[*]Submit issues
[*]Follow the status of your reports
[*]See which issues have been reported by others
[*]Vote on which issues matter most to you
[*]Search for specific reports
[*]Help contribute towards existing issues
[/LIST]

With the launch of our new Issue Tracker the Bug Reporting forums will now be archived and all reports will now use the Issue Tracker.

Thank you for all your support so far and for helping raise awareness of the issues that are affecting your gameplay!

notes.title: LostWinds Update
notes.content:
Greetings everyone,

Just a swift note on a new update to LostWinds we released today:

[list][*]Scenery objects (foliage, particle effects, etc) now respond to Enril (i.e. the cursor) passing over them, which makes the world feel that bit more responsive and alive.
[*]We reduced the amount of slow motion, especially when using the gust power on environment objects. This makes the game flow nicer; previously, any gust would cause significant slow motion for a few seconds.[/list]

Thanks for continuing to support Frontier games!

Enjoy!
